definitions.age_summaries: completed frames only; milliseconds; p95 uses nearest rank
definitions.cumulative_completed_wait_ticks: sum of pending wait for completed frames after full drain
definitions.cumulative_dropped_wait_ticks: sum of pending wait for discarded frames
definitions.fifo: 30 pending slots excluding running; full -> drop_new
definitions.frame_age_ticks: finish - capture; null if never completed
definitions.highwater: max pending count, excluding running, including admission before immediate dispatch
definitions.latest: one latest pending slot; replacement -> drop_replaced; running is nonpreemptive
definitions.pending_wait_ticks: wait until dequeue or discard, including replaced frames
definitions.queue_age_ticks: dequeue - capture; null if never dequeued
definitions.sample_latest: admit at >=200ms since last admitted capture, then latest; others -> drop_sampled

limitations: Synthetic frame timestamps and prescribed service times; no real video or model inference.
No hardware, visual-understanding or encoding measurements are produced.
Fixed 10s capture plus full drain demonstrates queue behavior only; not model performance advice.
Burst service is assigned by source frame ID; policies may complete different mixes of slow frames.
